description:
## Functional specifications
Extend existing People/IdentityResolver identity storage with connector/issuer scope. Link existing identities to the sole matching provider connector as approved; stop on ambiguous mappings. Test identifier collisions, forged/mismatched connector facts, concurrent discovery, email compatibility and merge behaviour. Do not infer membership from display names or emails.

## Files and ownership
lib/zaq/accounts/people.ex; lib/zaq/accounts/person_channel.ex; lib/zaq/accounts/person_merger.ex; lib/zaq/people/identity_resolver.ex; identity tests/migrations

## Action reuse assessment
Extend People identity discovery and merge, not another matcher. Trusted connector facts enter through Channels; unknown/ambiguous mappings fail closed.

## Tests to add before implementation / branches
Use the explicit scenarios in Functional specifications as acceptance tests; include denial, failure, concurrency and idempotency branches where applicable. Preserve existing passing assertions.

## Mocking plan
External transport/model/clock boundaries only; no blanket NodeRouter stubs.

## Documentation
docs/services/channels.md; identity moduledocs

Execution requirements: planning only until assigned for implementation. Preserve existing uncommitted work and progress comments; do not infer completion from historical tests. Read AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md and applicable service guides before affected work. Write immediate unit/integration/property regression tests BEFORE implementation. Mock only genuine external boundaries; keep internal domain paths real. Run isolated tests and mix q per issue; final precommit belongs to the dedicated final gate. New feature E2E authoring waits for zaq-emb.12. No commit/push authorization is implied.

comments.text: Human decision: link existing PersonChannel identities to the sole connector for their provider during migration (current ChannelConfig schema enforces one connector per provider); do not silently match usernames/emails or permit ambiguous issuer mapping. Maintain person-bound actors. For future multi-config, scoped identity must be unambiguous; reconcile PersonMerger and existing BO-owned channels. Action reuse: extend People/IdentityResolver and current channel identity schema, not a parallel global matcher. Tests first: legacy link, same external ID on different configs after uniqueness expansion, forged config rejection, concurrent first ingress; downstream event provenance trusted only via Channels boundary.

Started test-first. Resolver now checks supplied retrieval connector ID against normalized message provider before identity lookup (email:imap maps to email); regression tests cover mismatch and matching Slack/IMAP. Focused resolver tests and mix q pass. This is NOT connector-scoped storage/trusted-fact verification: channels still have global platform/identifier uniqueness and connector ID trust must be established at ingress. Keep issue in progress; do not claim complete.

Incremental implementation: unconsumed 20260922000003 connector-scope migration links legacy rows to sole matching retrieval config and raises on ambiguous provider mapping; scoped and null-only unique indexes; PersonChannel stores connector id, People match/discovery uses scoped identity (unscoped lookup excludes scoped rows), IdentityResolver passes connector and PersonMerger groups by connector. Focused 165 tests/4 properties pass; mix q pass after one transient ExDNA timeout retry. Remaining: prove ingress provenance at Channels boundary, same-provider multi-connector policy/uniqueness expansion, migration backfill and concurrent discovery tests; do not close yet.

Identified connector deletion contract prerequisite: newly scoped PersonChannel FK must not be ON DELETE SET NULL (would turn an authorized scoped identity into an unscoped identity, possibly collide). Unconsumed migration 00003 uses NO ACTION and follow-on 00005 updates already migrated test DB; focused FK regression passes. Existing BO ChannelsLive currently tears down ingress before Repo.delete! config and would crash/leave teardown when scoped identities block deletion. Need explicit human choice: reject deletion until identity cleanup vs delete identity rows transactionally; disable remains available. No commit/push.

Resolved ingress regression exposed by broader integration: Channels CommunicationBridge now discards connector IDs carried only by untrusted Incoming metadata and stamps ID from trusted bridge opts. For existing unscoped non-email PersonChannel rows created after migration, People links to the sole live provider connector transactionally under row lock; never guesses when multiple configs. Regressions cover sole-link, two-connector ambiguity, concurrent scoped discovery, archived ingress denial, BO archive identity retention. Broad person-credential ingress + identity + ChannelsLive suite 145 tests passes; mix q passes. Still open for legacy backfill migration validation and remaining identity/trust review; no commit/push.
